Facts: Li bought two suspected guns, sold one to Li5 (another case), kept one for self-use, lent to Li1 (already convicted for robbery). Later police seized gun parts, assembled into two guns, identified as self-made firearms with lethal power. So Li possessed illegal firearms, manufactured (self-made) firearms, possibly illegal trafficking (selling). Under Chinese law, crimes include:

- 非法持有枪支罪 (illegal possession of firearms)
- 非法制造枪支罪 (illegal manufacturing of firearms) – but he didn't manufacture from scratch? He assembled parts? The parts were purchased? He had self-made guns. Could be illegal manufacturing (including assembling). 
- 非法买卖枪支罪 (illegal buying/selling of firearms) – he bought and sold one.

Check if "非法买卖枪支罪" requires profit? He sold one. So yes.
